# recon-engine
> Ultra-fast Open-Source Statement Parser & Financial Reconciliation Engine in Bun.

## Core Capabilities
- Parsers: CAMT.053 (ISO 20022 XML), SWIFT MT940, Revolut CSV, Stripe CSV, Generic CSV.
- Matcher: Deterministic exact metrics + Jaro-Winkler fuzzy remittance matching + Wire fee deduction tolerance.
- Precision: Zero floating-point arithmetic. All money handled in integer minor units (cents).

## CLI Invocation for Agents
- Always use headless non-interactive mode:
  bunx @danyayen/recon-engine match --statement <file> --invoices <file> --json --yes
- Parse statement to stdout JSON:
  bunx @danyayen/recon-engine parse <file> --json

## Schema Specifications
- Full specs and agent execution protocols available in AGENT.md
